card.text: A star 41 parsecs away with two companions imaged directly: a brown dwarf and an inner giant planet.

sources.label: Kral et al. 2026
sources.quote: we monitored the astrometric positions of HD 206893 B and c

introduction.text: HD 206893 is a young star 41 parsecs away. VLTI/GRAVITY found its inner planet c in 2022, and now tracks its brown dwarf B closely enough to search it for a moon.

sources.label: Hinkley et al. 2023
sources.quote: we report a high significance detection of the companion HD206893c over three epochs

sources.label: Kral et al. 2026
sources.quote: This study presents the first application of high-precision astrometry to search for exomoons around substellar companions

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
